name: @repo/agent-sessions-cli
description: Agent sessions hook CLI — updates session status from Claude Code / Codex hooks
author: Alex Zhang

scripts.build:bundle: bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/agent-sessions-cli.js && for p in codex-session-event-writer claude-session-event-writer; do mkdir -p "../../plugins/$p/bin" && cp dist/agent-sessions-cli.js "../../plugins/$p/bin/agent-sessions-cli.js"; done
